what: Letters farther from where the pointer entered flicker later (.5 × distance) and fainter (.8 × distance, .2s sine.out), then sharpen over .75s power1.out — distance is a ratio of the element width (height for vertical text), so the touched letter stays as it is, and the letter at the opposite end ripples latest and faintest. A quiet hover that does not change color, like the thin serif menus of the inn and gallery

options.axis: Direction to measure distance — x (horizontal text line, default) · y (vertical writing — automatic when writing-mode is vertical) · xy (distance in both directions)
options.depth: Fade amount of the farthest letter (opacity = depth × distance), default 0.8
options.lag: Delay for the farthest letter (seconds), default 0.5
options.ease: Return curve, default power1.out — the original code "Expo.out" Written as such but it is not a name in GSAP 3, so it runs with the default curve (matches the measured 833ms)

use: ABOUT · Vertical menu: About the Inn
note: On touch screens (no hover) and with reduced motion, text is not split. When released, it reverts to the original text (child nodes)

from.where: shared.js letter wave hover (original Hover component — header menu · vertical booking label · booking window button · transit tab · cookie button)
